theme_strategy.rationale: A 'classic and professional' logistics platform prioritizes readability, data density, and trust. A light theme with deep navy and slate accents perfectly embodies authority and clarity (Archetype 4: Swiss & High-Contrast).

app_segments.marketing_page: High visual impact, generous spacing, striking hero image with subtle dark overlay, clear CTAs.
app_segments.admin_dashboard: High-density Grid Mode B. Fixed left sidebar, top utility bar, cardless or 1px bordered dense tables.
app_segments.courier_mobile: Mobile-first, oversized tap targets, high-contrast statuses, focused camera/signature view.
app_segments.customer_portal: Minimalist, timeline-focused, easy-to-read shipment history cards.

typography.rules: The Anti-Default Rule applies. Do NOT use Inter, Roboto, or Open Sans for headings. Use the designated classic corporate fonts below.

primary_font.name: IBM Plex Sans
primary_font.usage: Headings and prominent structural labels (Dashboard stats, Nav links).

secondary_font.name: IBM Plex Sans
secondary_font.usage: Body text, form inputs, table data.

rules: No full-screen gradients. Use solid colors.
Never use pure black (#000000) or pure gray (#808080). Use the slate palette which is tinted with cool blue.
Ensure minimum 4.5:1 contrast for normal text and 3:1 for large text.
DO NOT use teal green or teal blue (#1B93A4) anywhere.

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Generous Spacing for Marketing (p-8 to p-24) / High Density for Admin (p-4 to p-6).

grids.marketing: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-8 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-8 to gap-12. Asymmetrical balance.
grids.dashboard: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4 to gap-6. Every pixel utilized, h-full on children.
grids.dashboard_structure: Fixed left sidebar (w-64), top bar (h-16), scrollable main content area.

rules: Grid items MUST be direct children of grid containers.
If using framer-motion, the motion.div must be the direct child.
Mobile max height for images is 80vh.
Containers with borders must have internal padding (p-6) to prevent text collision.

surfaces.marketing_cards: Flat Solid backgrounds, subtle 1px border-slate-200, no drop shadows by default. Use hover lift (-translate-y-1) + shadow-lg.
surfaces.dashboard_widgets: Grid Borders (The Technical Look). border-collapse style, 1px subtle border, sharp or max 4px border-radius.
surfaces.headers: If content scrolls under, use Crystal Glassmorphism (bg-white/70 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-slate-200/50). If solid, use bg-white border-b border-slate-200.

buttons.style: Pill-shaped (rounded-full) or subtle rounded (rounded-md) depending on page. Marketing gets pill-shaped, Admin gets rounded-md.
buttons.interaction: ALWAYS set explicit hover text colors (e.g., hover:bg-sky-700 hover:text-white). Focus states must have higher contrast ring.

forms_and_tables.inputs: Shadcn UI customized. Solid borders, subtle focus rings (ring-2 ring-sky-500/50). Left aligned.
forms_and_tables.tables: Dense rows for Admin dashboard. Sticky headers. Status columns use colored pill badges.

tracking_timeline.style: Vertical line connecting dots. Active dots use status color, inactive dots use slate-200. Left aligned text describing status and timestamp.

hero_background.description: Red and blue cargo ship aerial view. Use with bg-black/40 overlay for text legibility.

warehouse_feature.description: Modern logistics warehouse shelving. Good for 'About Us' or feature sections.

courier_delivery.description: Delivery worker examining packages in a van.

rules: DO NOT use placeholder image URLs like placehold.it. Only use the curated images provided above.
Images used as backgrounds MUST have proper overlays (max bg-black/50 or bg-white/40) for text legibility.
Use specific property transitions (e.g., transition-transform duration-200 ease-out), NEVER 'transition-all'.
Add hover states to ALL interactive elements.
Courier mobile app needs snappy, immediate feedback interactions (e.g., swipe-to-complete or large tap animations).
All text must meet APCA or WCAG AA contrast ratios.
All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='track-shipment-button').
NEVER use fully transparent backgrounds for overlays, headers, or dropdowns.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the UI using React (.js files), Tailwind CSS, and Shadcn UI components.
For icons, install and use 'lucide-react' (default) or '@phosphor-icons/react' for a more premium feel.
Implement a robust layout architecture: distinct layouts for Public Marketing, Admin Dashboard, Customer Portal, and Courier Mobile-Web.
Ensure the Admin Dashboard follows a classic sidebar + topbar + dense content layout.
The Tracking Timeline component should be a central, highly polished visual element, using the defined status colors.
The Courier mobile-web flow must feel like a native app: sticky bottom action bars, large tap targets, and full-screen camera/signature canvases.
NEVER use HTML input type='date' or basic <select>. Use Shadcn Calendar and Dropdown/Select components.
Ensure you add data-testid attributes to all critical interactive nodes for robust testing.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Avoid 'AI slop'. Create distinctive, classic professional interfaces.
Dark colors look good when used independently. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts. Left-align text and forms.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy, but keep logistics data surfaces optically clear (solid).
You MUST NOT apply universal transitions (transition: all).
You MUST NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }).
Always use modern button styles with interaction animations and explicit hover colors.
NEVER use AI assistant emojis (🤖🧠💭) for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations. Static = dead.
Use generous spacing (2-3x normal) for marketing pages.
Missing categories? DO NOT use placeholder text for images. Use the provided URLs.
Prioritize Shadcn components. Override default opinionated heights (e.g., h-9 on tabs) when needed.
